about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Riley M. Moore

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF STATE, AND RELATED PROGRAMS APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
statements.title: NATIONAL SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF STATE, AND RELATED PROGRAMS APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2027
sentences: Mr. Chair, I rise in support of this legislation, and I thank Chairman Cole and Chairman Diaz-Balart for their leadership on this bill.
With this vote, we will express the support of this Chamber for the report we presented to the White House on how to end the Christian genocide in Nigeria.
I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING PRIVACY IN PURCHASES ACT
statements.title: PROTECTING PRIVACY IN PURCHASES ACT
sentences: This would, of course, become a de facto gun registry.

In 2021, the progressive Amalgamated Bank lobbied the International Organization for Standardization to create a separate merchant category code for firearm retailers to advance a backdoor gun registry.
It pressured a faceless, unaccountable, foreign standards body in Geneva to stand up a new merchant category code explicitly targeting American gun owners and American businesses.
Under my leadership as State treasurer, West Virginia enacted one of the first bans on separate merchant category codes for firearms retailers, protecting the privacy of our State's gun owners.
California, Colorado, and New York currently mandate that firearm stores have a separate merchant category code, creating a de facto registry in some of the most populous States in our country.
A private database of gun owners falling into the hands of a future anti-gun administration is a threat that we cannot accept.
Our God-given right to own a firearm does not stop at the border of blue States.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of my bill, H.R. 1181, the Protecting Privacy in Purchases Act.
We will not allow an elitist bank partnered with a foreign, faceless bureaucracy to rob Americans of their right to protect themselves.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FARM, FOOD, AND NATIONAL SECURITY ACT OF 2026
statements.title: FARM, FOOD, AND NATIONAL SECURITY ACT OF 2026
sentences: Forty percent of the revenue-sharing from the track supports the pension funds of police and firefighters, and we have had the Fraternal Order of Police and the International Association of Firefighters actually come out in support of this amendment because it will decimate those pensions of our retired police and firefighters, some of whom are disabled.
Those union members, who are just trying to scratch by in the State of West Virginia, are no longer going to be able to do that.
I will just note that this is destroying guys who have union pensions.
It is against the unions to vote against this amendment.
Mr. Chair, this amendment is in support of the unions, those union members.
If you vote against this, you are against the unions.
Ask the Fraternal Order of Police.
Just to be clear, this amendment is in support of the police.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR DISPOSITION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 7147, DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR DISPOSITION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 7147, DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: This bill that the Senate has passed, I am going to call it Hakeem's dream.
We are not going to pass this.
We are going to fund ICE, CBP, and HSI, and we are going to put a stop to the madness that has been going on in this country for far too long.

statements.title: PROTECT CHILDREN'S INNOCENCE ACT
sentences: They took minors who were looking at transitioning and actually gave them mental health counseling.
We have a mental health crisis in this country.
Madam Speaker, I rise in strong support of this legislation.
I rise in strong support of this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STATE PLANNING FOR RELIABILITY AND AFFORDABILITY ACT
statements.title: STATE PLANNING FOR RELIABILITY AND AFFORDABILITY ACT
sentences: Unfortunately, Democrat-led States have used these integrated resource plans to push woke climate and environmental justice goals, prioritizing leftwing ideology over making life affordable for American families.

I urge my colleagues to support this commonsense amendment to deliver reliable, affordable energy to American households and unleash America's golden age by ensuring coal, oil, and natural gas remain an integral piece of our energy mix.

statements.title: THE POWER OF PRAYER

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: It increases funding for the Capitol Police and provides support for security programs through the House Sergeant at Arms.
It is tough on foreign adversaries, including language that I wrote preventing the purchase of technology tied to the Chinese Communist Party.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today to support the Senate amendment to H.R. 5371, which includes full funding for the legislative branch.
Mr. Speaker, I thank Chairman Cole for his leadership and Ranking Member Espaillat and our subcommittee members and their staff and our staff for their work, and I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 4016, DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 3633, DIGITAL ASSET MARKET CLARITY ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 4016, DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 3633, DIGITAL ASSET MARKET CLARITY ACT OF 2025; PROVIDING FOR...
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the CLARITY Act, the GENIUS Act, and the Anti-CBDC Surveillance State Act.
I am a cosponsor, actually, of the CLARITY Act, which creates clear, enforceable rules for digital commodity markets and gives innovators confidence to build here in the United States of America.
Similarly, the GENIUS Act establishes a dollar-backed stablecoin, reinforcing the U.S. dollar's dominance in global financial markets.
Finally, the anti-CBDC legislation ensures that we never enact a CCP- like financial surveillance regime in this country.
Together, these bills ensure that the U.S. remains the world leader in digital asset innovation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, as chairman of the RSC Rescissions Task Force, I am proud to support this bill to codify the DOGE cuts.
They want us to eliminate Democrats' radical agenda, including $5.1 million for global LGBTQ movements, $3 million for circumcisions in Zambia, and $833,000 for transgender surgeries in Nepal.
This rescissions package is only the first step, and I urge my colleagues to support it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: We also make America prosperous again by providing the largest tax cut in history, including no tax on tips, no tax on overtime, and slashing taxes on Social Security.
Finally, this bill puts American families first by increasing and making permanent the child tax credit and enhancing the adoption tax credit and defunding, thank God, big abortion.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PERSECUTION OF CHRISTIANS
statements.title: PERSECUTION OF CHRISTIANS
sentences: This decision was driven by an Iranian-backed militia leader as a deliberate attempt to erase Christian influence in the region.

I urge my colleagues to join me in raising our voices for the persecuted, to honor their faith and bravery with action, and to ensure the United States is a beacon of hope for those suffering for their beliefs in Jesus Christ.
I will introduce a resolution condemning the persecution of Christians, and I urge this body to take up that resolution and pass it overwhelmingly. ____________________
